items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There was a guy named Jimmy. He played like Elvin.

ctx.x: When you were in college, who were the peers in your peer group that you were playing with at that time, besides Moses?

Moses. This is just about – not yet. I’m not meeting [Steve] Grossman and those guys yet. No, I am, because he was 16 and I’m 20, 21, through Mike Garson, who went into the Army and then found guys were playing. There was a guy named Jimmy. He played like Elvin.
